metadata.description: Hand-coded Hall/Van de Castle golden set (English). Same coding rules as golden_ru.json.

dreams.text: I lifted a floorboard and found gold coins. I filled my pockets with them. I gave a few figurines to a woman passing by. Then a second observer appeared and I pushed him away. I was told to dig near the trees, but I decided to dig somewhere else.
dreams.notes: English mirror of the acceptance dream. 'Observer ... him' is male by pronoun — pronoun-based gender is a documented recall gap.

dreams.text: A huge dog was chasing me through empty streets. I could not scream. Finally I climbed over a fence and escaped.
dreams.notes: Chase = aggression with the dreamer as victim; 'could not scream' = failure (modal inability, known recall gap); escape = success.

dreams.text: I was in my grandmother's house. My mother set the table, and my brother helped me carry heavy bags. Then my grandmother hugged me and gave me an old watch.
dreams.notes: Help, hug, gift = three friendliness acts; grandmother mentioned twice = one character.

dreams.text: I dreamed I won the lottery jackpot. My wife and I jumped with joy.
dreams.notes: Lottery win = good fortune, not success.

dreams.text: I played chess with an old man and won the game. He shook my hand.
dreams.notes: Winning a game = success (effort); handshake = friendliness.

dreams.text: There was no water in my dream. Nobody chased me, and I did not hit anyone. I could not find the exit from the building.
dreams.notes: All negated acts code nothing; 'could not find the exit' = failure. The building is in the scene, water is not.

dreams.text: I was taking an exam. I tried to solve the problem but failed the exam. The teacher yelled at me in front of the whole class.
dreams.notes: 'Tried to solve' names the goal, not an achievement — no success; teacher's gender is unmarked in English → neither male nor female count.

dreams.text: I was walking through a forest with my sister. A wolf attacked us, and I fought it off with a stick. My sister was scared, but I protected her. We finally reached the cabin and locked the door. Inside, we found warm food on the table.
dreams.notes: Attack and fighting back = 2 aggression acts (different incidents); protecting = friendliness; reaching safety = success; finding food = good fortune (no seeking narrated in that scene).

dreams.text: I met my ex-girlfriend at a party. She kissed me, and we danced all night. Her new boyfriend saw us and threatened me.
I was trying to fly but could not lift off the ground. I failed again and again, while other people flew easily above me.
dreams.notes: One narrated failed striving; other people flying is background activity.

dreams.text: A lawyer called me and said I had inherited a big house from an unknown uncle. I walked through the huge rooms feeling lucky.
dreams.notes: Inheritance = good fortune once; 'feeling lucky' is an emotion echo of the same fortune, not a second event. Lawyer's gender unmarked → indefinite.

dreams.text: I was sitting in a quiet room watching the rain outside the window. Everything was still and grey. I do not remember anything else.
dreams.notes: Zero-event dream: every count must be 0 and the A/F indicator must land in insufficient_data, not become 0.00.
